services.name: Two-Hour Private Charter
services.desc: Craft your Adventure! All Ages, Up to 6 Passengers 1-3 Passengers: $299 4-6 Passengers: $349 About Jolly Sailing offers private charters for up to 6 guests on a 32' Ericson sailboat. Hop on the Bushman's Friend and "take the helm" on your adventure, literally and figuratively! Want to sit sideways on a windy afternoon? You got it! Prefer a mellow sail paired with your favorite drinks and apps? No problem! Guests can go for a swim, help with the sails, play their own tunes, or anchor at Island White and wave to the sea lions. Don't worry, we have a restroom onboard. With Jolly Sailing 2 hours · All ages · Up to 6 passengers
